title: Diagonal charge--frequency modes obstruct finite-p closure by the same lifted energy

diagonal_modes.mode: Qe_(4N)=4N e_(4N); k_N=(4N,0,0); q_N=4N; phi_N=a_N exp(i k_N dot x)e_(4N)
diagonal_modes.energy_normalization: ||grad Q^n phi_N||_2^2+||Q^(n+1)phi_N||_2^2=1 up to fixed Fourier normalization
diagonal_modes.finite_p: sigma=3/p>0 for every finite p, so the demanded mixed norm diverges
diagonal_modes.endpoint: p=infinity gives sigma=0 and a bounded next-charge L2 norm
diagonal_modes.jointness: fixed charge or fixed spatial frequency misses the obstruction; both q_N and |k_N| grow on the actual 4N charge ladder
